items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I said I want you to meet Mr. Lou Singer.

ctx.x: That's right, in California. I introduced all the little drummers out there. I had 55 drummers. I said I want you to meet Mr. Lou Singer. I had a little boy up there and I have the pictures to prove. His name is Earl Palmer. I said, "Earl, this is Mr. Lou Singer." He looked at Lou Singer like he's a shoeshine boy. I said, "Son, you better get with this man and learn. You know about Gene Krupa, Buddy Rich, and Shelly Manne and those people but you haven't scratched the surface.
